# Personalisation & No-Lock Requirements Quality Checklist: 001

**Purpose**: Check that the Constitution XIII requirements in 001 (instruments, stages, packs, settings, no locks) are complete and testable.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is "nothing locked" defined over a closed list of reachable things (lessons, stages, drills, explorer, key helper, settings)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-065, §SC-012] — **GAP (spec-reviewer 2026-11-22)**
- [x] CHK002 Does every adaptive behaviour in 001 have a named user setting with a default? [Completeness, Spec §FR-067, Constitution XIII]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the first-run requirements complete: no instrument assumed, preset pick, defaults for every settings field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053, §FR-067] — **GAP (spec-reviewer 2026-11-22)**
- [x] CHK004 Is the full instrument edit set defined (name, tuning, string count, fret count, scale length; family not editable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how the library behaves when the active pack references a lesson that isn't in the build? [Gap, Spec §FR-063]

## Requirement Clarity

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Is the lesson preset rule (a built-in preset applied temporarily) consistent with "any gear", e.g. for a 7-string guitar opening a Drop D lesson? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, Constitution XIII]

- [x] CHK012 Do "lesson completion is informational" (FR-028) and any library ordering or highlighting avoid implying a lock? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, §FR-065]
- [x] CHK013 Is the per-instrument reporting (FR-042) consistent with per-family reporting (FR-055) and Constitution VIII? [Consistency, Spec §FR-042, §FR-055]
